summary: Narrow driveway lane with homes 3-15 m away and steep drop beyond.
reasons: Narrow lane, no room to pull off

drivers.seclusion: Dwelling 12 m (near 13 m) and 14 m (near 0 m) from the kerb; houses 5-10 m away at 61 and 88 m.
drivers.access_and_room: Single-width lane edged by trees, fences and driveways; a van would block residents' access.
drivers.traffic: Little traffic, but it is an access lane to private homes.
drivers.convention: Cars stand in driveways and a few near 0 m; no kerb parking along the lane.

flags: Dwelling within 10 m for most of the length
Steep beyond 70 m: up to 28.2% max grade
Low ground at the far end, about 7.6 m elevation, 144 m from Brisbane River
Gate 229 m away has a mapped way round
sun_shade: Heavy tree canopy over the lane; shaded most of the day.
cannot_judge: Whether the lane is public or private

best_section.where: East edge of the lane at its junction with Jilba Street
